title: Evacuation Routes Rally Points
description: A six-step process: set near-home, neighborhood, and out-of-area rally points, map primary and alternate routes, mark paper maps, practice the drives, and agree on communication protocols. Also covers when to leave early, signs you've waited too long, and evacuating with pets or special needs.
shortDescription: Set three rally points and three routes, then practice them
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
